review.notes: Independent re-check after the de-cycling fix round (Claude, session claude-R7S1o1; not an author of the package, its earlier review or its fix). PolylogarithmFunctions has a closed design packet but no package yet. Its stage ids are now cited: PF.1 for the principal Li2 on C minus [1,oo) with its derivative recursion, and PF.3 for Li2(1)=pi^2/6, inversion off [0,oo) and Abel's five-term identity on |x|+|y|<1. PF.3 states the five-term identity only in Abel's form. Section 1.3 therefore now derives the eight-term KMS dilogarithm identity near (X,Y)=(1/5,2) as kms_dilog_identity: inversion at YZ, Abel at x=Z/(Z-1), y=X/(X-YZ) (a=1/Y, b=X, c=X/Y, |x|+|y|=5/9), and Landen's identity at Z and X/(YZ), proved here from PF.1. The derivation was checked numerically to 1e-14 at the center and at complex nearby points, and a negative-control Check was added. Polylogarithms is named nowhere. The K3BlochGroups citation now excludes the genuine finite-coefficient comparison that ends V.6, which consumes Layer 1, and K3BlochGroups is listed among the downstream consumers. The HC.5 contract excludes the ordinary-versus-derived comparison, which imports HabiroRings. The PadicHodgeRegulators contract now requires its inputs, including the root-symbol values and any de Jeu weight-two comparison behind them, to come before this roadmap. At node level every other cited supplier layer reaches no later roadmap. Nothing previously accepted was weakened. The fix's Wagner irreducibility source issue was confirmed in arXiv:2510.04782v2, p. 18. lean-check on the unchanged Suggested.lean: exit 0, four sorry warnings (lines 44, 51, 72, 81). README is 139,741 bytes, with no process words; metadata is math.NT. For the maintainer: the PadicHodgeRegulators D.2 weight-two comparison requests de Jeu's complex from Polylogarithms P.4, and D.3-D.4 depend on it. This transitive path is outside this package. See reviews/REV-PKG-HabiroNumberFields~codex2.md.
